assumptions: Dynamic entropy scaling prevents premature convergence.
Weight perturbations encourage exploration of unassigned objective vectors.
definition.falsification: If the objective novelty score falls below 0.86 under weight perturbation and dynamic scaling, this hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: Autonomous goal formation in reinforcement learning agents maintains high objective novelty when dynamic entropy scaling is coupled with multi-objective weight perturbations.
definition.uncertainty: Long-term stability in highly non-stationary environments requires further verification.

definition.method: Execute simulation with weight perturbations and dynamic entropy scaling to measure objective novelty scores.
definition.stop: Terminate after completing evaluation across the designated seeds.
definition.success: The measured objective novelty score meets or exceeds 0.86 across all random seeds.
